emma: Hey team — customer hitting 401 when saving a prompt in the Console. They sent a screenshot that just says "Request failed: 401". Ticket #TCK-12345. Can we get exact repro steps we can send back?

support-bot: Got it. Please ask for browser + OS, UTC timestamp of the error, and any request IDs (X-Request-ID) shown in network. Also ask them to attach HAR + console logs.

rajat: If they can’t find X-Request-ID, ask them to reproduce while DevTools is open and either copy the network row or use "Copy > Copy as cURL" from the failed request. That gives us exact headers/payload.

sofia: Chrome step-by-step I usually send to customers:
1) Open Chrome DevTools (F12 or Cmd+Option+I)
2) Network tab -> check "Preserve log" and check "Disable cache"
3) Console tab -> check "Preserve log" too (so console retains errors)
4) Reproduce the error in the Console UI
5) In Network, right-click the failing request -> "Save all as HAR with content" -> save as my-repro.har
6) In Console, right-click -> "Save as..." or select all and copy -> save as console.txt
Please attach both files and the exact UTC timestamp when they reproduced it.

emma: Also ask whether they're on Hosted / Dedicated / Private (VPC). If Private, we need the internal request-id header only visible in their network. Remind them to redact API keys before attaching.

rajat: If they want to send a quick cURL repro, they can copy as cURL from Chrome (right-click request) OR run something like:

`curl -v \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-Request-ID: <copy-from-network>" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

sofia: If they prefer Firefox: DevTools -> Network -> right-click request -> "Save All As HAR". For console: Web Console -> Save visible messages or copy/paste.

sofia: Packaging/upload instructions: zip the HAR + console + any screenshots (e.g., repro-bundle.zip). They can upload via the support portal link (https://support.redwood.ai/upload) OR using curl if they’re comfortable:

`curl -X POST "https://uploads.redwood.ai/debug-bundles" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_UPLOAD_TOKEN" \n  -F "file=@repro-bundle.zip" \n  -F "ticket=TCK-12345" \n  -F "notes=Contains HAR+console logs; please redact keys"`

sofia: Quick tips for customers: include the exact time (UTC), which account/email, whether they used a specific model or route, and any browser extensions disabled. Tell them to reproduce once with extensions disabled.

emma: I’ll send these steps to the customer now. If they attach the files, please triage; if we see 401 + X-Request-ID we’ll escalate to eng-sre. Tagging @rajat for kernel-level look if needed. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Escalation created ENG-789 and assigned to eng-sre. Please upload attachments to the ticket.

emma: Thanks — will follow up after they upload.
